scene: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished background layer for a portrait A5 children's picture-book page, high-resolution 2048x2880 or larger if supported. Match the established reference's delicate tactile cut-paper watercolor gouache style, with clean readable large shapes and warm paper texture, sage greens, ochre details and a single coral-orange flower. NOT photorealistic. A single quiet country garden seen from the eye level of a small child: a curving pale gravel garden path through low grass; short weathered gray stone wall behind it; small cream plaster cottage with terracotta roof in far upper-right; sparse leafy branches frame upper-left; ONE recognizably same small coral-orange daisy with yellow center and two broad sage leaves, ROOTED in the garden earth, in foreground at lower-right around x76%, y76%. The flower is modest in size, no smiling face, no eyes. Fix geometry of this garden for later pages. Leave clear uncluttered space for a child in lower-left/center but DO NOT depict any person, body, head, silhouette or umbrella. Full-bleed portrait illustration, all important garden objects kept away from page edges. Bottom 15% naturally quiet pale gravel/cream wash for separately typeset Chinese text; integrate it softly, not a hard white box. No printed text, letters, frame, watermark, or page numbers. Scene action: white clouds have moved away, a soft dark slate-blue rain cloud arrives, fine rain has just begun over the path and flower. Rain is gentle and distinctly visible but not a storm; not night; keep warm readable greens and a silver-blue sky. No imaginary creatures, extra animals or added plot props.
bodyBase: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: independent reusable transparent child BODY action layer for an existing personalized children's picture book. Input image 1 is the exact approved BODY MASTER, not a scene. Create ONE sibling pose: standing, holding a straight umbrella shaft with the child's right hand (the hand appearing on viewer LEFT), gripping naturally in front of upper chest; the left hand remains lightly extended palm-up toward viewer RIGHT. DO NOT include the umbrella, shaft, head, hair, face, scenery, floor, cast shadow, text or watermark. Preserve the master child's anatomy, body scale, limb lengths, clothing cut and material exactly: mustard yellow knit sweater with ivory patch pocket, sage green cuffed shorts, cream socks, rust orange lace-up shoes. Same textured watercolor/cut-paper storybook treatment. This is the SAME child body, not a redesigned older/younger child. Keep torso and legs in the exact original standing stance. Transparent RGBA output, no fake checkerboard. Keep the complete neckline skin opening and both shoes fully visible with clear transparent margins. Preserve exact master image framing: portrait 1024 x 1536 canvas; collar center near x501 y225; soles near y1405. Keep the same source pixels per anatomical unit as input. The only changes should be fingers/forearm needed to form a believable grip around an imaginary vertical shaft centered near x370. This pose must accept the preexisting head without any change in head-to-body scale.

umbrella: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single separate umbrella PROP layer for a layered children's picture book. Canopy is viewed at child's eye level from slightly below, symmetric elliptical dome, 8 simple stitched panels, small beads of rain along the rim. Canopy full width approx 950 pixels, from x35 to x985, crown near y95, bottom scalloped rim near y420; vertical straight wooden shaft centered exactly at x512 and continues down to J-handle at y1320. Every canopy edge and full handle inside canvas with transparent margins. No human, hands, face, body, landscape, cast shadow, ground, glow, checkerboard, text, watermark or extra umbrellas.
